# TimeClockView

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTimeClockView` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTimePicker.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTimePicker.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTimePicker.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Time, clock face

## Overview

A round clock dial with a header showing the pending time. The header components (hour / minute / second / AM/PM) are clickable; the active component is selected on the face below. In 24-hour mode the hour face has two rings: outer 00,13-23 and inner 12,01-11 (Windows 10 style); in 12-hour mode a single 12,1-11 ring plus AM/PM in the header. Minutes/seconds use a 00-55 ring labelled in 5s and snap to the configured step. Used by UltraCanvasTimePicker for TimePickerPopupStyle::Clock, but works as a standalone element too.

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTimeClockView(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onTimeChanged` | `std::function<void(const UCTime&)> onTimeChanged` | Fired on every change made through the dial or header (live). |
| `onAccepted` | `std::function<void(const UCTime&)> onAccepted` | Fired when the last section has been picked (time fully chosen). |

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
